origin.reason_for_split: WATCHERS remains the incident dossier for 2026-08-26/28; this branch is a persistent forward-looking threat-intelligence and forecasting surface.

evolution: Chechnya 1994/1999: neutralize TV/satellite source and restrict independent coverage
Crimea/Sloviansk/Donetsk/Luhansk 2014: seize transmission/cable distribution and replace Ukrainian/local sources with Russian/aligned sources
Occupied Ukraine 2022+: seize frequencies/broadcast infrastructure and reroute Internet connectivity through Russian networks, inheriting Russian filtering/surveillance conditions
historical_distribution_control_state.attribution_caution: Abkhazia 1993 shows tower seizure by Russian-supported separatists but direct Russian command of that specific action is not established.
historical_distribution_control_state.insufficient_case: Transnistria 1992 remains unpromoted until a strong contemporaneous tower/transmitter seizure-source-substitution record is recovered.

digital_analog_state.remote_control_requirement: A shared Russian external command/control plane is required before any synchronized multi-country Russian activation claim; it is not established.
digital_analog_state.military_c2_boundary: Civilian-network TSPU/DPI can disrupt forces or partners that rely on commercial Internet/mobile paths, but does not automatically disable independent tactical radio, protected satellite, dedicated military networks or other non-ISP communications.

plateaus: Long-run Donbas attitudes cannot be reduced to propaganda alone because war, coercion, identity, local grievances and displacement confound causal attribution.
No causal design in this pass isolates the U.S.-federal-debt narrative itself as a driver of anti-U.S. attitudes.
Russian remote operational control of sovereign foreign DPI/SORM deployments is not established.
A synchronized multi-country external TSPU-like activation is not established.
x50_r2_state.outreach_result: Evidence base is mature enough to draft a non-accusatory strategic early-warning memorandum, but not to allege an active global TSPU operation.
